interpretations: For each patient sex that is neither NULL nor `''`, average the defined CPK ÷ GPT ratios across that sex’s lab tests. Compute the unweighted mean of those sex averages, keep sex groups strictly above it, then compute the unweighted mean of the kept averages and retain only groups strictly above that second mean. Return one unrounded row containing the mean ratio average of the final groups, their mean excess over the first mean, and their mean excess over the second mean.
queries:
WITH sex_averages AS (
    SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL
      AND p.SEX <> ''
      AND l.CPK IS NOT NULL
      AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL
      AND l.GPT <> 0
    GROUP BY p.SEX
),
first_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM sex_averages
),
above_first AS (
    SELECT s.avg_ratio
    FROM sex_averages AS s
    CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f
    WHERE s.avg_ratio > f.value
),
second_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM above_first
)
SELECT
    AVG(a.avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio_average,
    AVG(a.avg_ratio - f.value) AS mean_excess_over_first,
    AVG(a.avg_ratio - s.value) AS mean_excess_over_second
FROM above_first AS a
CROSS JOIN first_mean AS f
CROSS JOIN second_mean AS s
WHERE a.avg_ratio > s.value;
